name: Avenge My Village
summary: Makaba Flathoof asks Horde travelers to answer the Grimtotem assault on his village in southeastern Stonetalon. He barely survived, cut off from his kin and surrounded by the dead, and now seeks vengeance at the ruffians’ and hired sellswords’ encampment.

sections.title: Blood in the Crags
sections.body: Near the Barrens border, Makaba Flathoof is the lone survivor of a massacre in the red stone passes of Stonetalon. Grimtotem raiders descended without warning and slaughtered nearly everyone in his settlement. Makaba fought back and brought down several attackers, but they drove him into hiding with little more than his life and his wrath.

sections.title: The Grimtotem Menace
sections.body: The Grimtotem have long troubled the tauren tribes united under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Unlike the peaceful nomads of Mulgore, their warbands use ruthless ruffians and opportunistic mercenaries to seize territory and strike isolated settlements. Makaba has no thought of diplomacy or tribal kinship now. Only blood repaid with blood can answer his grief.

faq.answer: Makaba Flathoof is a tauren survivor encamped near the southeastern pass into the Stonetalon Mountains. The Grimtotem clan sacked his nearby village, and he seeks retribution against the raiders.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem attacking other tauren?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan rejects unity under the Horde and Cairne Bloodhoof's vision of peace. Fiercely territorial, xenophobic, and aggressive, they raid rival settlements, kill outsiders, and use armed thugs and hired mercenaries to claim regions such as Stonetalon.

faq.q: Where are the Grimtotem attackers located?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem ruffians and mercenaries are camped just west of Makaba Flathoof in southeastern Stonetalon, among rocky hills overlooking the pass.
The Grimtotem Clan hires ruthless fighters and sellswords to strengthen its warbands and terrorize and overrun isolated settlements.
After you cut down the frontline ruffians and mercenaries, Makaba asks you to strike at the leader behind the massacre, Grundig Darkcloud.
Makaba's settlement was an isolated tauren encampment near the border passes of southeastern Stonetalon. The Grimtotem raid wiped it out, leaving Makaba as one of the few known survivors.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see how Grimtotem treachery deepens the divide among the shu'halo. Their slaughter of their own kind shows the danger they pose to Cairne's united people.

As a member of the Horde, you depend on open, secure passes between the Barrens and Stonetalon. A rogue Grimtotem band killing travelers and allied villagers threatens the Warchief's supply lines through the mountains.
